description: DECISION 110a authoring-blind audit; Testbed labels {STRUCTURALLY_VALID, TRIVIAL_FAN_OUT, UNDECIDABLE} based on src+tgt+rel+textbook semantics only. Skunkworks vet labels not consulted.

label_definitions.STRUCTURALLY_VALID: Relation textbook-correct as stated; not derivable by single fan-out rule; requires authoring intent.
label_definitions.TRIVIAL_FAN_OUT: Relation derivable by single schema rule (e.g. 'X is operator -> X uses gradient'); artifact-likely.
label_definitions.UNDECIDABLE: Textbook context unclear OR relation type appears mis-applied (e.g. wrong direction/type) but not clearly fan-out.

audit_method: Pure textbook judgment on (src, rel, tgt); no peeking at vet decisions/authoring rationale/signature text; per DECISION 110a + 112a protocol.
